title: Your first part
summary: Sketch a rectangle, extrude it into a block, round an edge and drill a hole.

steps.title: Start a sketch
steps.text: Click Create Sketch and choose Top plane (XY). The view turns to look straight down on the plane.

steps.title: Draw a rectangle
steps.text: Pick the Rectangle tool (or press R), then click one corner and the opposite corner in the viewport. Any size will do.

steps.title: Finish the sketch
steps.text: Click Finish Sketch to go back to the solid tools. The rectangle stays as a closed profile.

steps.title: Extrude the profile
steps.text: Click Extrude (E), click inside the rectangle, type a distance such as 10 and press OK.

steps.title: Round an edge
steps.text: Click Fillet, click one or more edges of the block, set a radius smaller than the block and press OK.

steps.title: Drill a hole
steps.text: Click Hole, click a point on the top face of the block, check the diameter and depth and press OK.

finish: Your part has four features in the timeline at the bottom. Double-click one to change it, and the part rebuilds.
